title: Can I SURVIVE Chaturaji Chess?
summary: Chaturaji on chess.com: four players each get half a chess army (king, boat, knight, bishop, 4 pawns) and capture pieces for points. Placement scoring: 1st = 3 wins, 2nd = 1 win, 3rd = 1 loss, 4th = 3 losses. Goal: '3 wins' vs higher-rated opponents (1700, ~2000, 2200, 2300); achieved (+64 rating, ~1800).
rules: 4 players (Red moves first, then the others in turn), free-for-all; each has half an army in its own corner region of the 8x8 board: King, Boat, Knight, Bishop + 4 pawns.
Boat moves exactly like a rook; others move as in chess.
Pawns only advance one square (no double step); promotion on the far edge (he promotes to a boat).
Points for captures (intro card): pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 5, boat 5, king 3.
Game result by points ranking: 1st place = 3 wins, 2nd = 1 win, 3rd = 1 loss, 4th = 3 losses (rating effect); disconnected players' pieces stay/grey out.
